checks.detail: Good to know before you publish After you publish, you have 3 changes in total for your names, monogram and wedding date (changing several in one go counts once). Always free: fixing a small typo (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving your date by up to 7 days. Changed something by mistake? Undo it right away (before you publish it, or within 10 minutes) and you get the change back. Everything else — time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies — you can change as often as you like. Your website stays online until 18 September 2028, 12 months after your wedding. Then your website closes for guests; you can still see your content and download your replies.
